title: Excel Link Manager (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Excel Link Manager applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Excel Link Manager (BtnExcelLinkManager) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Link status resolution and last-refresh rendering pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production display rules pin: a link is 'Linked' only when the shape carries a source path at all AND that file exists (a gone file reports 'Missing', a shape without a source path can never be Linked), and the last-refresh tag renders through the current culture's short date/time ('g') with blank or unparseable tags showing an em dash. ExcelLinkManagerWindow delegates all three rules.
